newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-DIARY-Australia statistics schedule mid Dec.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-DIARY-Australia statistics schedule mid Dec.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics has scheduled the following figures for release mid December. Data are issued at 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT).
Sep 11 - Dwelling Unit commencements, June quarter
Sep 25 - Business Expectations survey, Dec quarter
Sep 26 - Job vacancies and Overtime, three months to August
Sep 27 - New motor vehicle registrations, August
Oct 07 - Housing materials price index, August
- Building materials (ex housing) price index, August
Oct 23 - Consumer Price Index, September quarter
Oct 24 - Average weekly ordinary time earnings, three months
Oct 25 - New Motor Vehicle Registrations, September
Oct 31 - Retail Trade, September and September quarter
Nov 04 - Housing materials price index, September
- Building materials (ex housing) price index, Sept
Nov 14 - Average weekly ordinary time earnings, three months
Nov 25 - Private new capital expenditure, September quarter
Dec 02 - Stocks and selected sales, September quarter
Dec 10 - Industrial Production Indexes, September quarter
Dec 11 - International Investment Position, December quarter
Dec 13 - Dwelling Unit Commencements, September quarter
